decisions.rationale: Open-fronted forge, 8 x 10 m: rubble back and side walls, a hearth with a brick hood and stack to 8.5 m, posts on the open front, shingle roof with eaves at 3.8 m; 200 triangles, 18,264 bytes before meshopt. Walls stay inside the oriented-box collider below 3 m and eaves overhang at most 0.78 m above it (check-kit: OK); baked AO at 48 samples.
limitations: No forge glow, smoke or embers: the forge is unlit.
Inside the open side the floor and back wall are plain layers.
Surfaces are tiled 2 m layers shared by the whole kit; there is no unique wear, grime gradient or decals per building.

decisions.rationale: In Roadward Inn and every settlement but Saltmarket and Hollow Village; an anvil and trough stand at its open side at gameplay cameras (18-40 m, pitch 0.38-1.13): reads at true scale beside the 2.25 m soldier, the 2.7 m captain and the 3.9 m boss; shadows ground it on the relief; the 1.6-3.2 m architecture cutaway keeps the hero visible behind it, and a camera inside its bounds (plus 2 m) hides it instead of showing the hollow inside.
limitations: Not enterable: interiors are not modelled.
Lighting is the overcast day grade only; windows never light up.
